app.empty_hint: Open a file or a link. The player remembers where you stopped.
app.no_file_picker: This device has no file picker. Open the file from a file manager using “Open with”.
settings.title: Settings
settings.language_import_hint: JSON file made from the template
settings.language_export_hint: Translate the strings and import the file back
settings.subtitle_override_hint: Always use the size and color above
settings.langs_hint: Language codes separated by commas, e.g. ru, en
settings.decoder_auto_hint: Hardware first, FFmpeg for unsupported formats
settings.decoder_ffmpeg_hint: Software decoding. Helps with broken audio or video on cheap TV boxes
settings.skip_hint: Found by chapter names, your marks or data from the calling app
net.title: Network folders
net.name: Name (optional)
net.err_share: Share not found or it requires a login. Check the folder name and enter your user name
net.err_path: Folder not found on the server
net.err_host: Server is not reachable. Check the address and that the device is on the same network
net.address_hint: Server only, e.g. \\192.168.1.10 — shares will be listed. Or a full path \\server\share\folder
net.no_shares: The server has no shared folders available to this user
net.domain_hint: Usually empty. Only for Windows domains/workgroups — not a folder path
handoff.hint: Open 2160 Player on the other device; both must be on the same network
handoff.failed: Could not send. Is 2160 Player open on that device?
settings.night_mode_hint: Dynamic range compression and dialogue boost. Disables passthrough to an AV receiver
settings.night_auto_hint: Turns on by itself from %1$s to %2$s, even mid-movie
settings.smart_tracks_hint: E.g. anime — Japanese audio with subtitles, movies — dub. Per series and per set of languages
settings.update_auto_hint: New versions from GitHub, at most twice a day
update.title: Update available
settings.background_hint: Keep the video's sound without picture when minimized or the screen is off
handoff.code_hint: Or enter the code from that device: it's in the request and in Settings → Hand-off between devices. Needed once.
handoff.code_locked: Too many attempts — wait a minute
settings.handoff_protection_hint: With several players on one network others can't see what you watch or start videos on your device. Works on the same Wi-Fi only
settings.handoff_off_hint: Any player on the network sees what's playing and can offer a video
settings.handoff_daily_hint: A new code every day; connected devices stay connected
settings.handoff_code_hint: Valid until midnight. Needed when connecting by code instead of the Allow button
settings.pip_hint: Home during a video opens a small window over other apps
settings.background_audio_hint: Audio files keep playing when minimized or the screen is off. Turn off to pause
handoff.pair_text: Allow it to see what you watch and offer videos? Or enter your code there
handoff.pair_text_code: Allow it to see what you watch and offer videos? Or enter code %1$s there
handoff.pair_waiting: A request appeared on “%1$s” — tap Allow there
share.title: Share the app
share.settings_hint: As a file, over Wi-Fi with a QR code or as a link — works offline too
share.file_hint: Quick Share, Bluetooth, Telegram, email… Works offline
share.wifi_hint: QR code and address: another device downloads the app straight from this one
share.link_text: 2160 Player — a player for phones and Android TV:
share.abi_warning: This file only fits %1$s devices. For older 32-bit TVs download the ARM build from the releases page.
share.wifi_none: No Wi-Fi connection. Connect to a network or turn on the phone's hotspot.
share.wifi_steps: On another device on the same network scan the QR code or open the address in a browser (on TV — in Downloader). Keep this window open while it downloads. No router: turn on the hotspot on the phone and connect the other device to it.
local.title: Files on device
local.subtitle: Internal storage, USB drives and SD cards
local.scoped_hint: Android only shows videos and music to apps: ISO images, subtitles and playlists may be hidden in some folders.
local.empty: No videos or music in this folder
local.error: Cannot open this folder — access denied
local.subtitle_file: Subtitles — attached to the video automatically
local.subtitle_no_video: No video with the same name next to it
local.permission_text: To show videos and music from device storage, a USB drive or an SD card, allow 2160 Player to access media files.
local.permission_denied: File access is denied. Turn it on in the app settings: Permissions → Music and audio, Photos and videos, or Files and media.
